name: PTT NZ Limited
notes:
PTT NZ Limited operates a mobile connectivity network across New Zealand and Australia.

Native mobile access:
- New Zealand: Spark NZ, One NZ and 2degrees
- Australia: Telstra (direct), Optus and Vodafone
- Global roaming is provided through our roaming partners.

Our network carries cellular data for IoT, enterprise and mobile-connectivity customers, with points of presence in Auckland and Sydney.

Peering requests: peering@pttnz.com (open policy, please include your ASN and the exchange/location).
